About

Time-served tradesman with over 45 years experience in domestic decorating offering a comprehensive, hassle-free end-to-end professional service focused purely on customer satisfaction.
Established in 1986 and covering Ruislip, Eastcote, Pinner, Northwood, Rickmansworth, The Chalfonts, Gerrards Cross, Chorleywood and surrounding areas. Full public liability insurance.
Working to the highest standards we start with comprehensive protection of surrounding areas, our thorough preparation process using our 95% DUST-FREE SANDING SYSTEM, we use the best preparation materials and the latest range of water based paints assuring a clean and healthy working environment and professional standard finishes.
Reliable, trustworthy, honest, respectful.
We now offer a hand painted kitchen refurbishment service so you don’t need to replace your old kitchen simply refurbish it.
